actual_scope: Can the 64-per-call centre path (eight rank-8 COPY/ERASE totals through the private temporary) be shared across calls or shrunk?
bottleneck_link: The centre path consumes 64 of about 99.6 unpaid coordinates per call, about 64% of the raw deficit, so its charge decides the packing ceiling's largest lever. This result pins the floor of that charge to the selected decoder contract's literal consumer demand: the eight COPY/ERASE totals are independent at the consumer (exact demand rank 8 on the pinned replay), so the charge cannot shrink under the pinned endpoint, and the sharing half inherits p112-batch-centre-floor's 64 rank(C) floor for independent demands.
stop_rule: Smallest instance first: one call's centre demand matrix and the k = 2 window coupling. Kill the shrunk route once demand rank 8 is pinned with an explicit minor; kill unconditional sharing on the first exact counterexample or record the precise missing datum. No search over other words, endpoints or alphabets; one bounded pivot only.
evidence: Pinned replay member candidate/strict/global/base/split-centres/GLOBAL-TEMPLATE.json.gz of research/community-frontier1094-audit/selected-replay.tar.gz. Both orientations parse to the same eight source rows (229, 224, 227, 225, 243, 241, 259, 257) with 28 fanout rows each at coefficients +-1/4 into consumer rows 112..223. The 112 by 8 consumer demand matrix has exact rational rank 8 with the explicit nonzero minor (rows 112, 117, 118, 120, 113, 116, 115, 123; determinant -1/16384), and the backward gather matrix equals the forward fanout exactly. Hence all eight totals are forced by the pinned endpoint: the copied information per call cannot drop below eight independent totals, and with the root-code per-total pairing-rank floor of eight (p112-batch-centre-floor, PR845, PR1098, PR1180) the charged 64 per call is rank-forced. The 144-call inventory (80 forward, 64 backward, 16 calls per stage over 9 stages) leaves the cross-call physical instantiation undecoded: owner nominations carry the centre source rows in only 16 of 1152 lookups. Controls: zero-column and merged-column rank drops, a fanout sign flip detected by gather equality, and a source-row swap rejected by the pinned tuple.

open_questions.question: Decode the physical instantiation of the centre source rows across the 144 calls: which calls, if any, share sink rows, return operator and chart within one uninterrupted window?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Sharing is physically admissible only for a genuinely coupled pair; this is the eligibility blocker PR 3075 names after its favourable k-call relaxation.
open_questions.first_step: Map local data rows through route_semantics (cover class d*rho(stage,port)) and the data_phases.py involution, then compare the eight source rows of every call pair at k = 2.
open_questions.blocked_by: The pinned owner nominations carry only 16 of 1152 source-row lookups; the data-row address map is in the route semantics, which this package does not decode.

open_questions.question: Can one centre total be delivered with pairing rank below eight (outside the root code)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The demand rank fixes eight independent totals, but the charged 64 also uses the per-total pairing-rank-eight floor; a cheaper total would shrink the charge without changing the endpoint.
open_questions.first_step: Test one specified outside-code overcomplete family by exact full-matrix replay and support pricing, following p112-batch-centre-floor's open question 1.
open_questions.blocked_by: An actual exact outside-code family; failed search is not exclusion.

open_questions.question: Can the consumer endpoint be changed to request a rank-deficient combination of the eight totals?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Demand rank 8 is an endpoint statement; a lower-rank demand would allow a reduced copied-total contract, at the price of a different endpoint.
open_questions.first_step: Derive one realized caller with a rank-deficient separable demand matrix and price its complete restoration, hosting and precision bill.
open_questions.blocked_by: No realized caller with compatible labels and a complete paid budget is known.
